architecture_assessment.verdict: Approve the proposed independent editable learning_skills design for an isolated implementation and new analysis generation; do not relax original parameter truth.
schema: Keep project_task and practice_check/acceptance rules separate from editable learning_skills (moderate component-level skills, not variable names or one-line syntax).

Keep original concepts and user constraints for traceability; mark whether each API/parameter choice is user-required or an adjustable implementation choice. Do not retroactively rewrite accepted historical analysis.
Use stable unit/skill IDs. Lesson teaches a transferable skill is different from lesson proves this exact project implementation, and neither means student mastery.
matching: First bind verified media identity and same-resource own fields; reuse existing URL/type/source/hash controls.

Match sources against skill statements, not trip_id, exact demo constants, success checks or project-specific formulas. Known APIs explicitly in a skill still need literal source identifiers or a separately approved exact equivalence.

Use a bounded semantic layer for translation/skill paraphrases, with known IDs and continuous exact quotes validated against retained own text. No free-form links, generated course facts or cross-source stitching.

At most two calls per job, total task deadline and cost cap; no GET-time model calls, no automatic retries beyond that cap. Persist only derived decisions with stable input/source fingerprints and revalidate on read.
Reject generic foundation-only, wrong tool, neighboring topics, prerequisites-only, future/TODO, negatives and demos. Preserve actual source scope and unknown stage.
display: Show source-declared/title topic, own-body/catalog teaching and project-application validation as distinct levels. Do not present a title lead as body-verified coverage.
Skill-family-only and prerequisite counterfactuals require independent relevance review; do not automatically count the 9 experimental positives as restored learning routes.
Keep API 13some/18none vs UI body/catalog12some/19none until actual new decisions are independently validated; all31 remain 0full for original requirements.
test_plan: Unseen skill/tool pairs and multilingual paraphrases; same-source exact quote/hash/ID validation.
Explicit API, negation/prerequisite/future/cross-lesson poisoning and wrong-tool cases; project parameters stay unknown on general skill matches.
Schema/reviewer/timeout failure remains unknown; source/skill changes invalidate stored decisions; GET stays pure.
Measure newly useful transferable-skill materials separately from parameter/project checks and source-access failures.

limitations: No new HTTP/model calls, no new source availability test, no live DB access and no production edits.
Counterfactual candidate sampling bounded to5 retained verified-media candidates per proposed skill; absence is not proof of platform unavailability or no suitable course.
Claims about all19 layer mixing are structural observations; individual root causes remain nonexclusive and several require deeper source review.
